simple.meaning: קַל (qal) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “light ; (by implication) rapid (also adverbial).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 13 times across 2 Samuel, Job, Ecclesiastes, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 3 more, beginning at 2 Samuel 2:18. Its contexts include family line, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קַל (H7031).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קַל (qal) / H7031 is traced through 2 Samuel 2:18, Job 24:18, Ecclesiastes 9:11, Isaiah 5:26 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: The three sons of Zeruiah were there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.
“They are foam on the surface of the waters.

I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away,

that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”
but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore those who pursue you will be swift.
“How can you say, ‘I am not defiled.
Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky.
Flight will perish from the swift;
neither shall he stand who handles the bow;

definitions.full: H7031. qal קַל adjective light, swift, fleet ; — masculine singular ׳ק Amos 2:15 +, קָ֑ל vAmos 2:14; feminine singular קַלָּה Jer 2:23 ; plural קַלִּים Isa 18:2 +; — בְּרַגְלָיו קַל light with his feet Amos 2:15 ; 2Sam 2:18 ; ׳ק , alone, swift , messengers Isa 18:2 , pursuers Lam 4:19 ( מִן compare), camel Jer 2:23 , cloud Isa 19:1 ; of swift vanishing of wicked Job 24:18 (Bu קַלּוּ for הוּא קַל ); as substantive Amos 2:14 ; Jer 46:6 ; Eccl 9:11 , = swift (horse) Isa 30:16 ; קַל as adverb, swiftly (+ מְהֵרָה ) 5:26 ; Joel 4:4.
